description: A copy of ALM's O/A/x2: two channels, each multiplying its input by an attenuverter and adding a fixed voltage to the result

params.text: Adds a fixed voltage to the first channel, -10V to +10V, and comes up at the centre where it adds nothing
Scales the first channel's input between -2 and +2, silent at the centre of its travel and inverting below it; it comes up at the centre
Adds a fixed voltage to the second channel, -10V to +10V, and comes up at the centre where it adds nothing
Scales the second channel's input between -2 and +2, silent at the centre of its travel and inverting below it; it comes up at the centre

inputs.text: The signal the first channel scales; with nothing patched the channel puts out its offset alone
The signal the second channel scales; with nothing patched the channel puts out its offset alone

outputs.text: The first channel's input times its attenuverter plus its offset, clamped to ±12V
The second channel's input times its attenuverter plus its offset, clamped to ±12V; with MIX MODE on the first channel's result is added here too, unless a cable is in the first channel's output

notes: both attenuverters come up at the centre, where they pass nothing at all. A fresh module puts out only what the two offset knobs are set to, which is 0V.
the two lamps beside each output show the sign of that output, one for voltage above 0V and one for below, reaching full at 10V.
the module is monophonic: every jack reads or writes one channel.
menu: MIX MODE — adds the first channel's result into the second channel's output; the addition stops while a cable is in the first channel's own output jack

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.

bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
